new_this_pass.note: Time-late report: tanker struck by unknown projectile in engine room, 6NM north of Khasab, outbound Hormuz transit; crew safe and accounted for. Report body gives no explicit incident date; API date (22:25Z, 2 min before registration) is a registration-time stamp per the standing pattern (cf. #211). Gulf News places the strike at 1645 UTC Nov 18 — same calendar day, so the API date stands as-is.
